detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Data center GPUs are designed for massive forced air cooling in server racks.

My little homelab doesn't need to sound like a jet turbine while idle, so I assembled this.  It's a high-amp fan controller with both user adjustable and temperature sensor control.  I'll stick the temp probe into the primary GPU's heatsink.  So it'll have responsive cooling just like a consumer GPU.

The modern maker would probably deploy a Pi zero for this.  Old-skool is best sometimes.  And cheap.
